` | Bind host address for proxy server | `127.0.0.1` | | `--port ` | Proxy API port (OpenAI & Anthropic endpoints) | `52111` | | `--ui-port ` | Glassmorphic Web UI dashboard port | `52110` | | `--daemon` | Start or manage process in background | `false` | | `--version`, `-v` | Display current installed version | `1.2.10` | | `--help`, `-h` | Display all available commands and help | - | --- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer & Risks > [!WARNING] > **Independent Open-Source Software & Risk Notice:** > - **Prime Gate Antigravity Proxy** is an independent open-source project and is **NOT affiliated with, endorsed, or approved** by Google LLC or Anthropic PBC. > - Accessing internal Google Antigravity endpoints outside official extensions may violate service terms. > - **ACCOUNT SECURITY NOTICE:** **NEVER** use your primary Google account, work email, or sensitive personal accounts. Always use a dedicated secondary experimental Google account. All usage risks rest entirely with the user. --- ## 🤖 Latest Supported Models Catalog Prime Gate dynamically resolves and translates available upstream Antigravity models into standard OpenAI and Anthropic compatible slugs: | Model Name | API Slug | Context Window | Reasoning / Thinking | Modality | Best For | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Claude Sonnet 4.6** | `claude-sonnet-4-6` | 200,000 tokens | ✅ Adaptive CoT | Text + Vision | Agentic coding, Claude Code CLI, Cline, Roo Code | | **Claude Opus 4.6** | `claude-opus-4-6` | 200,000 tokens | ✅ Deep Reasoning | Text + Vision | Complex architecture, refactoring & planning | | **Gemini 3.8 Flash** | `gemini-3.8-flash` | 1,000,000 tokens | ✅ Ultra Fast | Multimodal | High-throughput, bulk context, rapid reviews | | **Claude 3.7 Sonnet** | `claude-3-7-sonnet` | 200,000 tokens | ✅ Hybrid Thinking | Text + Vision | Multi-turn chat & interactive pairing | | **Claude 3.5 Sonnet** | `claude-3-5-sonnet` | 200,000 tokens | ❌ Standard | Text + Vision | General software engineering & code generation | --- ## ⌨️ Complete Terminal Commands Cheatsheet All commands can be invoked using `prime-gate ` (if globally installed) or `npx prime-gate-antigravity `: ### 1. Service & Daemon Management ```bash prime-gate daemon start # Start background daemon (Proxy API + Web UI) prime-gate daemon status # Inspect daemon state, PID, memory, and uptime prime-gate daemon stop # Stop all background proxy and UI services prime-gate daemon restart # Cleanly cycle and restart the background services prime-gate start # Run proxy in foreground (interactive terminal mode) prime-gate ui # Launch the Web UI dashboard directly ``` ### 2. Google Account Authentication ```bash prime-gate auth login # Interactive Google OAuth login (opens browser) prime-gate auth list # List all connected Google accounts & status prime-gate auth switch # Switch active upstream Google account prime-gate delete-account --email # Remove a specific connected account prime-gate clear-accounts # Wipe all connected upstream accounts ``` ### 3. Client Gateway API Keys & Access Policies ```bash # Create client API key with rate-limit and daily token policies prime-gate keys create --name "MyCursorKey" --rpm 60 --tpd 1000000 prime-gate keys list # View active client keys, limits, and usage prime-gate keys revoke # Instantly revoke access for a specific key ``` ### 4. Quota, Updates & Database Maintenance ```bash prime-gate quota # Display real-time quota balances across all models prime-gate check-update # Check npmjs.org registry for new releases prime-gate db check # Run CRC32 integrity check & diagnostics prime-gate db vacuum # Reclaim storage and defragment SQLite WAL prime-gate db rollback # Restore database from previous snapshot ``` --- ## 🔌 Quick AI Client Setup Connect your favorite coding agent to Prime Gate in seconds: ### 1. Claude Code CLI (Native Anthropic Protocol) ```bash # Set environment variables export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:52111" export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="pg-live-..." # Generate with: prime-gate keys create # Launch Claude Code directly claude --model claude-sonnet-4-6 ``` ### 2. Cursor IDE / Cline / Roo Code / Continue.dev (OpenAI & Anthropic API) * **Base URL:** `http://127.0.0.1:52111/v1` * **API Key:** `pg-live-...` (Generate via `prime-gate keys create` or Web UI) * **Model ID:** `claude-sonnet-4-6` or `gemini-3.8-flash` ### 3. OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`) Connect OpenCode with full tool-calling and thinking support: **Recommended: Native Anthropic Protocol (Zero OpenAI content guard errors):** ```json { "providers": { "antigravity": { "type": "anthropic", "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:52111", "apiKey": "pg-live-your-key", "models": ["claude-sonnet-4-6", "claude-opus-4-6-thinking", "gemini-3.8-flash"] } } } ``` **Alternative: OpenAI Protocol (Fully compatible with v1.2.10 tool-result & persistent thought-signature normalization):** ```json { "providers": { "antigravity": { "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:52111/v1", "apiKey": "pg-live-your-key", "models": ["claude-sonnet-4-6", "gemini-3.8-flash"] } } } ``` 📖 *For step-by-step guides for Aider, Roo Code, LibreChat, and SDKs, see [Complete User Guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md#6-ai-client--ide-integration-guide).* --- ## 📸 Web Dashboard Preview Prime Gate features an Anthropic-inspired dark glassmorphic interface accessible at `http://127.0.0.1:52110`: * **Live Telemetry & Token Speed** (`/dashboard`) * **Request Ledger & Latency Benchmarks** (`/benchmarks`) * **Multi-Account Manager & Quota Status** (`/accounts`) * **Streaming Prompt Sandbox & Playground** (`/sandbox`) * **SQLite WAL Database Sentinel & Audit** (`/sentinel`) 👉 **[Explore Full High-Resolution UI Screenshots](docs/SCREENSHOTS.md)** --- ## ❓ Troubleshooting & FAQs ### 1. `503 Service Unavailable: MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` * **Cause:** Google Antigravity servers are experiencing peak demand for that model. * **Resolution:** Prime Gate automatically attempts failover to your secondary account. Alternatively, switch active account via `prime-gate auth switch ` or switch model to `gemini-3.8-flash`. ### 2. `Errno 10048 / Address already in use` * **Cause:** Another instance of Prime Gate or service is occupying port `52111` or `52110`. * **Resolution:** Run `prime-gate daemon stop` to terminate background instances, or specify custom ports: ```bash prime-gate start --port 52120 --ui-port 52121 ``` ### 3. `401 Unauthorized` on AI Client Requests * **Cause:** Missing or invalid Client Gateway API key. * **Resolution:** Generate a key with `prime-gate keys create --name "DevKey"`, then pass it in your client's `Authorization: Bearer pg-live-...` header or `x-api-key` header. ### 4. `Command prime-gate not found` (Windows Users) * **Resolution:** Install globally using `npm install -g prime-gate-antigravity@latest`, or run `scripts\setup-path.ps1` to configure user PATH automatically. --- ## ## 📖 Übersicht **Prime Gate** ist eine schlanke und robuste API-Bridge, die den internen Cloud AI Companion / Antigravity-Dienst von Google in eine **OpenAI-konforme** (`/v1/chat/completions`) und **native Anthropic Messages API-kompatible** (`/v1/messages`) REST- & SSE-Schnittstelle kapselt. Nutzen Sie Ihre Google Antigravity-Kontingente – darunter **Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking)**, **Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking)** und **Gemini 3.8 Flash** – direkt in Ihren bevorzugten AI-Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie **Claude Code CLI**, **Cline**, **Roo Code**, **OpenCode**, **Cursor**, **Continue.dev**, **Aider** und **SillyTavern**. --- ## 🌟 Hauptfunktionen 1. **Dual-Protokoll-Unterstützung (OpenAI & Anthropic Native):** Vollständige Unterstützung für OpenAI- und native Anthropic-Endpunkte (`/v1/messages`) zur direkten Anbindung von Claude Code CLI. 2. **Mehrsprachiger semantischer Vektor-Cache:** Lokaler FastEmbed ONNX-Vektor-Cache mit SQLite WAL-Persistenz (~12ms TTFT). 3. **Enterprise-Sicherheit (AES-256-GCM):** Lokale Anmeldedaten werden mit AES-256-GCM und OS-Keyring geschützt; granulare Client-API-Key-Richtlinien (RPM / TPD). 4. **Echtzeit-Denkprozess-Streaming (Thinking Mode):** Liefert Reasoning-Chunks via `choices[0].delta.reasoning_content` in Echtzeit. 3. **Keine 400 Bad Request Fehler (Schema Sanitizer):** Bereinigt automatisch nicht unterstützte JSON-Schema-Einschränkungen (`exclusiveMinimum`, `$schema`, `additionalProperties`) für stabile Tool Calls. 4. **Automatische Kontingent- und Tariferkennung:** Erkennt **`Google AI Pro (Trial Tier)`** vs **`Paid Tier`** und listet nur verfügbare Modelle auf. 5. **Modernes React 18 + TypeScript SPA-Dashboard:** Vite-gestützte modulare Web-App mit dedizierten Routen (`/dashboard`, `/benchmarks`, `/accounts`, `/sandbox`, `/sentinel`), Echtzeit-Token-Radar, Konten-Verwaltung und interaktiver Test-Sandbox. 6. **Leistungsstarke CLI:** Befehle wie `--version`, `quota`, `auth` und Hintergrund-Daemon-Verwaltung für Windows. --- ## 📸 Web UI Dashboard Galerie 👉 **[Vollständige hochauflösende Screenshot-Galerie ansehen](../../docs/SCREENSHOTS.md)** --- ## ⚡ Schnellstart ```bash # Sofortiger Start via NPX (Kein Git Clone erforderlich) npx prime-gate-antigravity daemon start # Quota anzeigen npx prime-gate-antigravity quota # Oder global via NPM installieren npm install -g prime-gate-antigravity prime-gate daemon start ``` ### Web-UI-Onboarding 1. Öffnen Sie Ihren Browser unter **`http://127.0.0.1:52110`**. 2. Falls noch kein Konto verknüpft ist, erscheint das Anthropic-Setup-Overlay: - Klicken Sie auf **"Sign in with Google"** für Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE. - Oder wählen Sie **"⚡ Quick Import from OpenCode Config"**. 3. Utilisez vos quotas Google Antigravity – y compris **Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking)**, **Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking)** et **Gemini 3.8 Flash** – directement dans vos environnements de développement IA préférés : **Claude Code CLI**, **Cline**, **Roo Code**, **OpenCode**, **Cursor**, **Continue.dev**, **Aider** et **SillyTavern**. --- ## 🌟 Fonctionnalités clés 1. **Prise en charge double protocole (OpenAI & Anthropic Native) :** Compatibilité native avec les clients OpenAI et Anthropic (`/v1/messages`), connectant directement Claude Code CLI. 2. **Cache vectoriel sémantique multilingue (Semantic Cache) :** Moteur vectoriel FastEmbed ONNX local avec persistance SQLite WAL (~12ms TTFT). 3. **Sécurité Entreprise renforcée (AES-256-GCM) :** Chiffrement matériel des identifiants locaux via OS Keyring et contrôle d'accès granulaire par clé API (RPM / TPD). 4. **Streaming du raisonnement en temps réel (Thinking Mode) :** Transmet les blocs de réflexion via `choices[0].delta.reasoning_content` pour Claude 4.6 et Gemini 3.8. 3. **Zéro erreur 400 Bad Request (Nettoyeur de schéma récursif) :** Supprime automatiquement les contraintes JSON Schema non supportées (`exclusiveMinimum`, `$schema`, `additionalProperties`) pour une exécution stable des outils. 4. **Détection intelligente des quotas et abonnements :** Distingue automatiquement **`Google AI Pro (Trial Tier)`** de la version **`Paid Tier`**. 5. **Tableau de bord SPA moderne React 18 + TypeScript :** Application web modulaire sous Vite avec routes dédiées (`/dashboard`, `/benchmarks`, `/accounts`, `/sandbox`, `/sentinel`), graphiques de tokens en direct, gestion multi-comptes et bac à sable interactif. 6. **Suite CLI complète :** Commandes interactives `--version`, `quota`, `auth`, et gestion du démon en arrière-plan sous Windows. --- ## ## [1.2.10] - 2026-10-27

### 🛡️ Thought Signature Sanitization & Google Official Skip Validator Bypass
- **Thought Signature RFC 4648 Base64 Sanitization:** Implemented strict Base64 decoding validation (`is_valid_base64()`) and sanitation pipeline (`sanitize_thought_signature()`). Upstream protobuf errors (`Invalid value at 'request.contents[...].thought_signature' (TYPE_BYTES), Base64 decoding failed`) caused by non-Base64 tokens or corrupted cache entries are now completely eliminated.
- **Official Google Skip Validator Bypass:** Integrated Google's official bypass token `skip_thought_signature_validator` (per Google Gemini documentation) for synthetic, client-injected, or cross-turn historical tool calls. Removed legacy exclusionary filters that prevented the bypass string from passing upstream.
- **Cascading Multi-Tier Signature Resolution:** Re-architected resolver hierarchy:
  1. *Tier 1:* Strict `call_id` match.
  2. *Tier 2:* `call_hash` (deterministic MD5 of function name + canonical arguments).
  3. *Tier 3:* Official Google bypass token (`skip_thought_signature_validator`).
  Eliminated loose cross-tool function name guessing (`get_by_fn`) to prevent token contamination across distinct tool executions.
- **Production Database Test Isolation:** Fixed test harness in `tests/test_thought_signature_persistence.py` using isolated `tmp_path` SQLite databases, preventing mock tokens (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_CRYPTO_TOKEN_TEST==`) from polluting the live production database (`data/prime_gate.pgdb`).
- **Complete Test Coverage & Upstream Verification:** All 135 unit and integration tests passing 100% green; multi-turn reasoning tool-use calls verified live against upstream Google Antigravity endpoints.

### T-001: Fatal Runtime NameError pada Variabel `REC_MODEL` di Server
- **Keparahan:** **CRITICAL**
- **Fase Terkait:** Fase 3E & Fase 4
- **Lokasi:** [`prime_gate/server.py:1110`](file:///C:/Users/HUAWEI/Desktop/Belajar%20Python/prime-gate-proxy-antigravity-lik/prime_gate/server.py#L1110)
- **Deskripsi & Dampak:** Pada fungsi pemuatan model akun di server, kode memanggil `db.set("models:latest", db_models, REC_MODEL)`. Namun konstanta yang diimpor dari `prime_gate.db.binary_codec` adalah `REC_MODELS` (jamak). Jika blok baris 1110 dieksekusi saat cache model kosong, sistem akan melempar fatal `NameError: name 'REC_MODEL' is not defined` yang menyebabkan HTTP 500 pada klien.
- **Saran Perbaikan:** Ubah `REC_MODEL` menjadi `REC_MODELS` pada baris 1110 `prime_gate/server.py` dan perbaiki impor modul.

## F. Hasil Evaluasi Lintas-Fase

### 1. Regresi
Tidak ditemukan regresi fungsional pada endpoint warisan (v1.0 - v1.2.3). Seluruh 118 test suite tetap hijau. Karena Fase 5.7 (migrasi compactor/loop killer ke plugin middleware) belum diimplementasikan, alur lama tidak mengalami gangguan struktural. Namun, temuan `REC_MODEL` (T-001) merupakan cacat baru yang harus dieliminasi.

### 2. Kompatibilitas Mundur
Sangat baik. Database engine `BinaryDatabaseEngine` mendeteksi format lama (V1 legacy XOR) dan memigrasikannya ke format terenkripsi (V2 AES-256-GCM) secara idempoten dan otomatis saat pertama kali dibuka. Migrasi skema tabel baru (`pg_api_key_usage`, `pg_auto_update_ledger`, kolom kebijakan rate limit) menggunakan `IF NOT EXISTS` dan `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` tanpa menghapus data yang ada. Data tetap berada di `./data` sehingga pengguna tidak kehilangan kredensial akun atau riwayat cache.

### 3. Keamanan End-to-End
Proteksi lapis ganda bekerja dengan sangat baik:
- **DNS Rebinding:** Ditolak dengan 403 Forbidden via validasi Host header (`tests/test_dashboard_security.py:23`).
- **CSRF:** Dilindungi via double-submit cookie `pg_csrf` dan header `x-csrf-token`.
- **Kredensial At-Rest:** Terenkripsi AES-256-GCM dengan master key OS Keyring.
- **Pembersihan Log:** Modul `Redactor` menyaring token OAuth, refresh token, dan API key secara deterministik.
- **Celah Tersisa:** Kurangnya autentikasi pada `/metrics` (T-002) dan ketiadaan filter SSRF untuk gambar eksternal (T-004).

### 4. Kepatuhan Upstream
Kepatuhan terhadap batas ketentuan Google Antigravity terpenuhi:
- Tidak ada modul yang menyamarkan pola trafik klien (*traffic spoofing*), meniru pola ketikan manusia, atau memalsukan identitas peramban.
- Cache multi-turn `thoughtSignature` (Gemini 3) hanya menyimpan dan mempropagasi token tanda tangan kriptografi yang dihasilkan upstream secara sah untuk mencegah error 400/502 pada turn tool-calling berkelanjutan.
- Cooldown akun (6 detik saat 429) menghormati batas rate limit upstream.

### 5. Kejujuran Dokumentasi
README.md dan antarmuka Web Dashboard telah mematuhi prinsip kejujuran:
- Seluruh jargon pemasaran mutlak ("100% Anti-Banned", "Zero Token Waste") telah bersih.
- Peringatan Disclaimer & Risiko serta Known Limitations ditampilkan secara transparan di awal dokumen.
- Kartu simulator ekonomi diberi judul "Nilai Setara API Komersial" dan menjelaskan pemakaian kuota langganan Google Antigravity.

### 6. Kualitas Kode
Arsitektur database dan kriptografi sangat bersih dan modular (`prime_gate/crypto/` dan `prime_gate/db/`). Namun, `prime_gate/server.py` telah tumbuh terlalu besar (3.444 baris) dan bertindak sebagai modul monolitik yang menelan banyak tanggung jawab. Terdapat 72 peringatan Ruff (kebanyakan unused imports dan f-strings tanpa placeholder).

### 7. Kinerja & Keandalan
- **Database Concurrency:** Pemanfaatan SQLite mode WAL (`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL`) dan busy timeout 5000ms mencegah database locks pada akses konkuren tinggi.
- **Connection Pooling:** Shared HTTPX connection pool (`get_shared_client()`) mencegah socket port exhaustion di lingkungan Windows.
- **Process Lifecycle:** Bug desinkronisasi versi saat update telah diatasi via `_get_effective_version()` yang me-reload modul `prime_gate` dari disk secara dinamis.

### 8. Dependensi
Dependensi frontend pada `ui/package.json` bersih tanpa celah kerentanan (`0 vulnerabilities`). Dependensi Python pada `requirements.txt` memiliki temuan kerentanan pada `pillow 12.3.0` (35 CVE terdeteksi) yang perlu dinaikkan versinya.

### 9. Deployment
Konfigurasi saat ini berfokus pada deployment mandiri di sistem operasi Windows via detached daemon (`prime-gate daemon start`) dan skrip batch Windows (`scripts/*.bat`). Dukungan untuk Docker containerization (Dockerfile multi-stage, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK) dan skrip portable POSIX (`.sh`) belum tersedia (Fase 5.6 MISSING).

# Panduan Observabilitas & Monitoring (Observability Guide)

Prime Gate Antigravity Proxy menyediakan visibilitas tingkat produksi melalui metrik standar Prometheus, probe kesiapan (readiness) dan kelangsungan (liveness), pelacakan terdistribusi (`X-Request-ID`), serta logging terstruktur.

---

## 1. Prometheus Metrics (`/metrics`)

Endpoint `/metrics` mengekspos metrik runtime dalam format OpenMetrics/Prometheus standar (`text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8`).

### Daftar Metrik Utama

| Metrik | Tipe | Label | Deskripsi |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primegate_requests_total` | Counter | `protocol`, `model`, `status` | Total request proxy yang diproses |
| `primegate_request_duration_seconds` | Histogram | `protocol`, `model` | Distribusi durasi pemrosesan request (latensi) |
| `primegate_time_to_first_token_seconds` | Histogram | `protocol`, `model` | Waktu hingga chunk token pertama pada streaming (TTFT) |
| `primegate_tokens_total` | Counter | `type` (`prompt`, `completion`, `reasoning`, `saved`) | Akumulasi konsumsi dan penghematan token |
| `primegate_cache_hits_total` | Counter | `type` (`exact`, `semantic`) | Total kejadian cache hit |
| `primegate_cache_misses_total` | Counter | - | Total kejadian cache miss |
| `primegate_active_accounts` | Gauge | - | Jumlah akun upstream aktif dan terautentikasi |
| `primegate_account_failovers_total` | Counter | - | Total perpindahan akun otomatis akibat 429/503 |
| `primegate_compactor_tokens_saved_total`| Counter | - | Total token prompt yang dihemat oleh Context Compactor |

### Konfigurasi Prometheus Scraper (`prometheus.yml`)

```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "primegate-proxy"
    scrape_interval: 10s
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:52111"]
```

---

## 2. Health & Readiness Probes

### A. General Health (`/health` atau `/v1/health`)
Mengembalikan ringkasan status operasional, database SQLite WAL, model health, dan snapshot telemetri.

### B. Kubernetes Liveness Probe (`/health/liveness`)
Memverifikasi bahwa proses proxy berjalan dan mampu merespons request.
- Status Code: `200 OK`

## 8. Compiled Binary Database & Sentinel Watchdog

Prime Gate does **NOT** store plaintext JSON files:
- **Database Location:** `data/prime_gate.pgdb` (SQLite WAL format).
- **Binary Obfuscation:** Credentials, OAuth tokens, and quotas are packed into binary records (`REC_ACCOUNT`, `REC_MODEL`, `REC_QUOTA`).
- **Cryptographic CRC32 Integrity:** Every record is verified with a 32-bit CRC32 checksum before being decoded.
- **Autonomous Sentinel Watchdog:** Audits the binary file every 5 seconds. If bytes are altered or corrupted, an alert is broadcast over WebSocket (`/ws/live`) to the Web UI console.

## 10. Enterprise Engine & Resilience (v1.2.0)

Prime Gate v1.2.0 introduces four enterprise-grade runtime mechanisms designed for autonomous coding agents (Cursor, OpenCode, Continue, Claude Code, Cline):

### 1. Smart Agent Context Compactor
- **Problem:** AI coding agents generate multi-turn dialogues with verbose command outputs (`cat`, `read_file`, `git log`), inflating context from 20k to over 100k tokens and causing latency spikes or context truncation.
- **Solution:** `ContextCompactor` slides over conversation history and prunes verbose tool output blocks older than the active window (default 3 turns; max 40 lines). The first 20 and last 20 lines are preserved, with middle lines compressed.
- **Safety Guarantee:** User messages, assistant text, system prompts, and recent turns remain strictly preserved unaltered.

### 2. Transparent Mid-Flight Account Failover
- **Problem:** When an account runs out of quota mid-session, upstream Google Antigravity returns HTTP 429 (`RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`), breaking the client IDE stream.
- **Solution:** `AccountFailoverPool` intercepts 429/503 errors before the first SSE chunk is yielded to the client. It marks the failing account in cooldown (120–300s) and transparently connects to the next healthy account.
- **Client Experience:** Seamless session continuity, avoiding dropped streams or manual account switching.

### 3. AI Agent Runaway Loop Sentinel
- **Problem:** Autonomous agents sometimes repeat failing tool calls indefinitely with identical arguments, draining quota.
- **Solution:** `AgentLoopGuard` hashes tool call signatures. If $\ge 3$ consecutive identical tool calls are detected, Sentinel injects a surgical system intervention advising the model to stop repeating and re-evaluate.

### 4. Estimasi Nilai Setara Tarif Komersial (Commercial API Tariff Estimator)
- **Live Commercial Cost Equivalents:** Menghitung estimasi nilai komparatif terhadap tarif resmi API OpenAI/Anthropic (GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmark) dalam mata uang USD dan IDR. Pengguna memanfaatkan kuota langganan akun Google aktif.

## 11. Troubleshooting & FAQs

### Q: Why did I receive "503 Service Unavailable: MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED"?
**A:** Legacy models like `gemini-2.5-pro` and `gemini-2.5-flash` have severe upstream server constraints. Prime Gate has removed them from the default catalog. Please switch to **`gemini-3.8-flash`** or **`claude-sonnet-4-6`**, which have ample capacity.

### Q: How do I resolve "Address already in use (Errno 10048)"?
**A:** A previous instance of Prime Gate is running. Stop it with:
```bash
python -m prime_gate.cli daemon stop
```
Or start Prime Gate on a different port:
```bash
python -m prime_gate.cli start --port 52120
python -m prime_gate.cli ui --port 52121 --api-port 52120
```

### Q: Can my OAuth credentials or tokens leak to GitHub?
**A:** No. All sensitive data is stored inside `data/prime_gate.pgdb`, which is ignored by `.gitignore`. No plaintext tokens or secrets exist in the repository.
